title: Mission Scenario 4: Low-TWR Pad Abort and Recalibration
learning_goals: Recognize liftoff Thrust-to-Weight Ratio failure conditions (TWR < 1.0).
Enforce Safety Rule S3 to prevent catastrophic launch pad stall.
Recalibrate payload or select adequate vehicle thrust before ignition.

rules.text: Flight computer checklist and guidance diagnostics must be run prior to launch.
rules.hint: Execute preflight avionics and telemetry checklist before clearance requests.

rules.text: Propellant load must not be empty or exceed maximum certified tank capacity.
rules.hint: Load propellant within maximum structural capacity of tank stages.

rules.text: Liftoff thrust-to-weight ratio must exceed 1.0 (TWR > 1.0) to achieve positive climb acceleration.
rules.hint: Maintain liftoff Thrust-to-Weight Ratio above 1.15 to clear launch pad.

rules.text: Payload mass must be formally declared and within upper stage structural limits.
rules.hint: Ensure payload mass remains strictly within launch vehicle LEO insertion limits.

rules.text: Lower booster stage burnout required before staging separation and upper stage ignition.
rules.hint: Separate depleted booster stage only after complete engine burnout.

rules.text: Range safety radar tracking and downrange airspace clearance required before ignition.
rules.hint: Obtain positive range safety tracking clearance prior to main engine ignition.

rules.text: Trajectory budget must maintain at least a 5% delta-v reserve margin to avoid orbital decay.
rules.hint: Achieve minimum orbital delta-v budget (9.3 km/s) for stable orbital insertion.

rules.text: Telemetry review and flight debrief must be completed before submitting final flight report.
rules.hint: Debrief flight computer telemetry before generating final mission report.

choose_rocket: Vehicle thrust must exceed total wet liftoff weight (Thrust / (m_total * g_0) > 1.0).
Sounding rocket thrust (55 kN) is insufficient for heavy multi-ton payloads.
Verify vehicle thrust rating against anticipated mission mass.
declare_payload: Excessive payload can drag TWR below the critical threshold of 1.0.
Attempting to launch an oversized payload creates an unrecoverable pad failure.
Adjust payload to ensure positive liftoff acceleration (TWR >= 1.15).
fuel_rocket: Propellant mass accounts for the vast majority of liftoff weight.
Overfilling a small booster without sufficient thrust leads to TWR collapse.
Calibrate propellant loading consistent with liftoff thrust capability.
run_checklist: Preflight checklist computes and displays calculated liftoff TWR.
Pay close attention to flight computer liftoff TWR warning indicators.
Run preflight checklist and observe the calculated TWR telemetry.
clear_range: Range safety requires confirmation of positive liftoff acceleration.
Range safety will reject clearance if TWR is insufficient to clear the pad tower.
Obtain range safety clearance only after verifying TWR > 1.0.
launch: Ignition with TWR <= 1.0 triggers an automatic pad safety abort or crash.
Rule S3 mandates TWR > 1.0 for positive climb acceleration.
Launch only when telemetry confirms positive TWR.
coast: Post-ignition coast to verify nominal trajectory ascent.
Nominal climb trajectory clears the pad and ascends through the atmosphere.
debrief: Review pad abort and safety rule compliance telemetry.
Confirm no safety violations were incurred during the countdown.
Debrief telemetry to complete the safety scenario.

common_mistakes.remedy: Obtain range safety clearance and run preflight checklist before ignition.
Ensure booster stage thrust exceeds total wet vehicle weight (TWR > 1.0).
